title: Joint Diffusion Models in Continual Learning
caption: Figure 2. Overview of JDCL. To adapt the global model to task τ + 1, we first train a local joint diffusion model on task τ + 1 only. We then use the global model and the local model to generate a synthetic dataset consisting of samples from tasks 1, 2 . . . τ + 1. Finally, we fine-tune the global model with the generated dataset and a combination of joint diffusion and knowledge distillation losses.
